messages:
Ava Lin: Quick design ask — we need a small asset set for next Wednesday's launch:
- Benchmark card stack (3 sizes: hero, mid, social tile) showing latency vs cost sparkline
- Webinar hero (1280x720) with registration CTA
- Inbound routing diagram (one-pager PNG + figma) to show lead flows: demo / webinar / enterprise
Must be brand-safe + accessible. Timeline: first drafts by EOD Monday. Any gaps? :wave:

Samir Patel: Ack — can you paste the copy + the preferred model benchmark numbers? Also which color palette (old or v2)?

Ava Lin: Copy below. Bench numbers: p99 latency 120ms, p50 35ms, cost $0.002/token (avg) — show relative. Use v2 palette (see style guide link). Voice: 'Serve LLMs reliably at predictable cost.'

Priya Desai: Routing notes — webinar signups -> /webinar (utm=webinar) -> HubSpot form -> demo SDR queue. Enterprise leads click 'contact sales' -> enterprise intake form -> backfill to Dedicated capacity page. Include conversion points and expected SLAs.

Jordi: For the diagram, show 'Triage within 4 hours' for enterprise leads. Add webhook example:
```
POST /hooks/leads
{
  "email": "",
  "org": "",
  "interest": "",
  "mql_score": 0
}
```
We need those fields in the flow.

Samir Patel: Q on accessibility — contrast ratio for sparkline ticks? I'll ensure WCAG AA for text and 4.5:1 for CTAs. Any font overrides? We use Inter variable.

design-bot: Auto-check: v2 palette accepted. Figma template created: https://figma.com/file/xyz/redwood-launch-assets. Checklist: deliverables: PNG hero 1280x720, SVG sparkline variants, 3 tile sizes (1200x628, 800x800, 600x314), inbound-diagram PNG + source figma page. Add alt text for images.

Ava Lin: Also need a 60s animated GIF of the benchmark sparkline for social — low priority but would be great. Samir, can you estimate?

Samir Patel: 1-2 days for static, +1 day for GIF if we keep it simple (sparkline animate in). I'll start comping tonight. :clock1:

Priya Desai: Legal-approved line to include: 'Results approximate; performance varies by model and config.' Legal already okayed it. Add callouts for Dedicated vs Hosted.

Jordi: Add UTM example: ?utm_source=launch&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=inference-econ — use that in hero CTA link.

Samir Patel: noted :eyes:

Ava Lin: Thanks team — I'll add assets to the marketing board and ping once copy updated. Flag blockers here. :thumbsup:
